title: Role-play lab: six rebalancing conversations
objectives: Answer six rebalancing conversations using bands, costs and client approval.
Use the module's scenario answers (Q21–Q25) as trainer-marked practice.
body_md:
In pairs. One person plays the client, the other explains — in plain words, with a rupee example. Scenarios: The happy winner — Rohan's 60/40 is at 68/32 and he doesn't want to sell equity. After a fall — Leela's 60/40 is at 50/50 and she wants to wait. Small drift — a client at 62/38 asks to rebalance. Hidden holdings — Arun's funds look 80% equity, but he has ₹30 L in PPF and FDs. Goal near — Priya's goal is 2 years away; she asks to “rebalance to 60/40”. Recent SIP units — a rebalance would redeem units bought 6 months ago.

> **Investor takeaway:** Quiz scenarios Q21–Q25 (trainer-marked): a scenario answer earns its mark if it covers at least three model points and makes no promise of returns.
example: Role-play Rohan: band breached (68/32 vs ±5), new money first, then partial switch/STP, check loads and tax, record his decision.
say: Explain the band, use new money first, check costs, record the decision.
Within the band: costs may outweigh benefits.
never: Rebalance on request regardless of the band.

check.q: After a strong year, Rohan's 60/40 portfolio is at 68/32 and he doesn't want to sell equity. What do you do?
o: Explain the band was breached; use new money first, then a partial switch or STP; check loads and tax; record his decision
check.why: Explain the band was breached; use new money first, then a partial switch or STP; check loads and tax; record his decision.

check.q: Leela's 60/40 is at 50/50 after a sharp fall and she wants to wait. What do you say?
o: Remind her of the agreed rule; explain buying lower without predicting the bottom; consider staging the move; no market predictions
check.why: Remind her of the agreed rule; explain buying lower without predicting the bottom; consider staging the move; no market predictions.

check.q: A client at 62/38 asks to rebalance immediately. What do you explain?
o: It is within the ±5-point band; costs may outweigh benefits; direct new SIP money if anything
check.why: Explain it is within the ±5-point band; costs may outweigh benefits; use new SIP money if anything.
